upright.general: The Three of Swords symbolizes pain, tears, grief, loss of a loved one, anxiety, and disappointment, which can cause severe depression. It is possible that the person being read for has been abandoned and is in a state of apathy. Constant failures have knocked them out of the normal cycle of life. They are irritated and constantly quarrel with others. They may also have heart problems.
upright.in_love: The card views feelings as a broken heart. If a man (or woman) is single at this stage of life, they will not be able to find their soulmate yet. New acquaintances may worsen their depressive state even further. If they already have a family, they should prepare for a difficult period in the relationship. Quarrels, misunderstandings, and rudeness from the partner (or vice versa) are possible. Frequent conflicts can lead to divorce. This process will not be easy and cannot be resolved peacefully; claims, division of property, and other negative events can severely damage the nerves. If the querent is in a new relationship, a breakup of this union may occur. However, if the relationship has already cooled down and there was no opportunity (or desire) to break it off, such a situation will turn out to be favorable.
upright.in_situation: If we are talking about how the situation will unfold at work, one must prepare for trouble. There is a threat of dismissal or downsizing. Conflicts with colleagues and management will heat up the atmosphere in the team. Against this background, many ill-wishers may appear. If the querent is a business owner (or holds a managerial position), the card predicts that they may lose their position and influence. Unsuccessful deals, massive financial losses, and other misfortunes will have to be somehow endured.
upright.meaning_for_today: Today is an unfortunate day. An unpleasant piece of news awaits the querent at work. Alternatively, you will need to make a right decision that will require serious emotional effort.
upright.card_advice: There are no dead-end situations. You need to give yourself a certain amount of time to come to terms with the pain. Now, more than ever, comes the understanding of life values. The card advises showing resilience in the face of trouble. How a person proves themselves will determine their entire life in the future. Sufferings are given to people for their spiritual growth. As soon as a wise understanding of life values arrives, peace and tranquility will settle in the soul. Soon everything will change, and a chain of happy events will not pass by the person being read for. Everything has its time.

reversed.general: The reversed card indicates that the querent might have rejected love themselves, which they are now deeply regretting. Thoughts arise about the frailty of earthly existence, the meaninglessness of life, etc. Perhaps the querent plans to enter a monastery. This is likely due to the fact that their energy potential is reduced to zero. There is no faith that destiny will grant happy events. Life has lost all meaning for them. Others consider them bitter and rude, simply because they do not know the reasons behind their behavior. They make more and more mistakes by committing thoughtless actions.
reversed.in_love: The Three of Swords in a reversed position indicates that the union is doomed to a short-lived existence. Relationships that have become a habit bring no satisfaction to anyone. The person being read for will learn a secret about their chosen one, and this information will be a 'blow to the heart.' After this, there can be no talk of even friendly relations. This love connection was fragile from the very beginning. Infidelities are revealed sooner or later. It may also happen that the querent finds themselves in a love triangle. They will have to make decisions that will force them into a compromise with their conscience. Unseemly acts will bring emptiness and suffering.
reversed.in_situation: In its reversed form, the card is interpreted as trouble in all spheres of a person's life. They trust business partners in vain, as they are being deceived. In the workplace, the person is constantly gossiped about, and intrigues are built against them. People do not want to work with them, and by combining their efforts, they will try to get rid of them. Management values completely different employees. They may lose their job in the near future. In addition, they will have to seriously worry about financial losses. Regarding health, the Three of Swords signals that attention should be paid to kidney stones. A surgical operation is ahead. It is not excluded that the person suffers from serious mental disorders and urgently needs the help of a psychiatrist.
reversed.meaning_for_today: Today may bring a sense of emotional release after a difficult period. While old wounds or painful memories could resurface, their purpose is to help you understand what still needs healing. You may recognize that a situation which once caused great suffering is gradually losing its power over you. Allow yourself to process lingering emotions without becoming trapped in them, and remember that recovery is already underway.
reversed.card_advice: Do not cling to past disappointments or reopen wounds that are ready to heal. Accept what cannot be changed and focus on restoring your emotional balance. Forgiveness—whether of yourself or others—can be a powerful step forward. Give yourself permission to move on, learn from the experience, and trust that every hardship contains the seed of future growth and wisdom.
